note: Help text for gravity alerts that have none in rules.json: the overall alert, the pattern and the BMD and strength tracker workouts and overall. Read by the detail view.

gravity_overall.label: Overall: gravity
gravity_overall.howToMeasure: Calculated by the app from this module's indicators; you do not measure it.
gravity_overall.whyItMatters: It combines the module's signals into one status so no single reading raises an alert alone. Act means follow the suggested action and contact the flight surgeon.
gravity_overall.action: Follow the suggested action on the alert card. For Act, contact the flight surgeon.

bone_muscle_risk.label: Possible bone and muscle risk
bone_muscle_risk.howToMeasure: Calculated by the app from exercise sessions and the low food intake note; you do not measure it.
bone_muscle_risk.whyItMatters: Low exercise together with low food intake is a possible risk to bone and muscle. Looking at both together avoids an alert from one reading alone.
bone_muscle_risk.action: Follow the suggested action on the alert card and review exercise and the menu with the flight surgeon.

workouts_this_week.label: Workouts this week
workouts_this_week.howToMeasure: Tick each day's strength and endurance training in the weekly table of the BMD and strength tracker. Only days up to today count.
workouts_this_week.whyItMatters: NASA found 6 to 7 exercise sessions a week effective to maintain bone in spaceflight. Fewer days is a possible risk to bone and muscle.
workouts_this_week.action: Plan the next sessions this week and ask the flight surgeon if you keep missing them.
workouts_this_week.source: NASA OCHMO-TB-030 (6 to 7 exercise sessions a week); scoring is a design value
